# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 4 tokens; Text — 10 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 7 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 29 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 12 tokens; Radius — 8 tokens; Shadow — 2 tokens; Height — 14 tokens; Layout — 4 tokens; Font size — 15 tokens; Line height — 5 tokens; Letter spacing — 1 token; Font weight — 3 tokens; Phone — 16 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--canvas, #ffffff);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--canvas, #0c0d0f);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #ffffff;
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--canvas` | #ffffff | #0c0d0f | The base: page canvas. Pure white in light. |
| `--surface` | #f7f7f6 | #191b1e | Grey surface inside the white base: cards (filled, no border), code blocks, tool output. |
| `--surface-2` | #f1f1f0 | #222428 | Second surface step: selection thumbs on white, secondary pills, chat bubbles, crew-mark discs. |
| `--surface-3` | #ecebe7 | #2a2c31 | Third surface step; pills darken one surface step on hover. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css

/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */

/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #17181a;
```

### Tokens (10)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--ink` | #17181a | #17181a | Raw pop ink: the text on the vermilion and volt fills (`on-needs`, `on-done`) and the done edge. |
| `--fg` | #17181a | #eceae5 | Primary text and the ink pill fill, on `canvas`, `bg`, `surface`, `surface-2`, `surface-3` (11.6:1 or more in both themes). |
| `--fg-2` | #3c3b37 | #b8b7b1 | Secondary text (settled rows, body in lists) on `canvas`, `bg` and every surface step (6.9:1 or more). |
| `--fg-3` | #6f6e68 | #908f89 | Tertiary text (meta, captions, timestamps) on `canvas`, `bg`, `surface`, `surface-2` (4.5:1 or more in both themes; 4.3:1 on `surface-3`). |
| `--fg-4` | #9d9c96 | #6f6e69 | Quaternary text: placeholders and disabled labels. Kept from the source below 4.5:1 (2.75:1 on white, 3.8:1 on dark canvas): never for text that must be read. |

| `--text-2` | #3c3b37 | #b8b7b1 | v1 alias of `fg-2`. |
| `--text-3` | #6f6e68 | #908f89 | v1 alias of `fg-3`. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 500 30px/1.1 "SF Pro","SF Pro Display",system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Helvetica Neue",sans-serif;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-type-display);
font-family: var(--font-head);   /* the family alone */
```

